m: हट् cl. 1. P. हटति, to shine, be bright, Dhātup. ix, 25.
a: हट् — {c1c} P. (हटति, हटित) To shine, be bright.

s: tvizi । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰aka॰-sew .) tvizi dIptO ॥ hawati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: dIptO BvA॰ pa॰ aka॰ sew । hawAti ahatIt--ahAtIt
na॰ hawaM dIptiM piparti pF॰ bA॰ ni । SEvAle Sabdara॰ ।

m: हट्टाध्यक्ष m. the surveyor of a market, L.
हट्टी (ई), f. a petty market or fair, L.
a: हट्टी — A small market or fair.

s: puM, krayavikrayasyAnam । hAwa iti BAzA । ityamaraH । 3 । 5 । 98 ॥
v: pu॰ hawa--wa wasya nettvam । kravavikrayasTAne (hAwa) amaraH । “pratihawwapaTe GarawwajAditi” nEza॰ ।
m: हट्ट m. (cf. अट्ट) a market, fair, Pañcat.; Vet.
a: हट्टः — [हट्-ट टस्य नेत्वम्] A market, a fair. --Comp. --चोरकः a thief who steals from fairs and markets. --विलासिनी {1} a wanton woman, prostitute, common woman. {2} a sort of perfume. {3} turmeric.

s: puM, (hawwasya cOraH । tataH kan .) cOraviSezaH । hAwacora iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । mallIkaraH 2 mAcalaH 3 cillABaH 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ vandIkAraH 5 prasahyacOraH 6 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: pu॰ hawwe prakASite sTAne eva cOraH svArTe ka । (hAwacora) cOramede Sabdara॰ ।
m: हट्ट—चौरक m. a thief who steals from fairs and markets, L.
हट्ट—चन्द्र m. N. of a grammarian (often quoted).
हट्ट—वाहिनी f. a gutter in a market-place, Subh.
हट्ट—वेश्माली f. a row of market houses, L.

s: strI, (hawwe vilasatIti । vi + lasa + Rini । NIp .) ganDadravyaviSepaH । tatparyyAyaH । DamanI 2 aYjanakeSI 3 hanuH 4 । ityamaraH । 2 । 4 । 130 ॥ asyAH paryyAyo yaTA, -- “naKaM vyAGranaKaM vyAGrAyuDantaccakrakArakam । naKaM svalpanaKI proktA hanurhawwavilAsinI ॥” iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe praTame BAge ॥) haridrA । iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ pustakAntare harivilAsinIti ca pAWaH ॥ (vArANganA । yaTA, AryyAsaptaSatyAm । 433 । “mfgamadanidAnamawavI kuNkumamapi kfzakavAwikA vahati । hawwavilAsini BavatI paramekA pOrasarvvasvam ॥”)
v: strI hawwaM vilAsayati vi + kama--RicRini NIp । 1 ganDadravyaBede amaraH । 2 haridrAyAYca BAvapra॰ ।
m: हट्ट—विलासिनी f. ‘dallying in market-places’, a wanton woman, prostitute, W.
a sort of perfume (= धमनी), L.

k.v: धमन्यञ्जनकेशी च हनुर्हट्टविलासिनी। शुक्तिः शङ्खः खुरः कोलदलं नखमथाढकी॥
